name: City Council Special Meeting Agenda - Community Center Project Meeting (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  (Notice No. N2M23-129)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Alhambra will be hosting a Community Meeting
regarding the upcoming building of an Alhambra Community Center on Wednesday, October
25, 2023, commencing at 5:00 p.m. at 612 West Shorb Street Alhambra, California. It is
intended that this will be a City staff/consultant run meeting and the discussion will focus on the
upcoming building of a Community Center in the City of Alhambra. However, due to the
possibility that three (3) or more members of the Alhambra City Council may attend this
meeting, which will include a discussion of the project, a presentation of renderings for the site
and the solicitation of public input on the future Community Center, notice of a special meeting
of the Alhambra City Council is hereby given in an abundance of caution pursuant to the order
of the Mayor of the City of Alhambra, the Alhambra City Charter, the Alhambra Municipal Code
and Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

Dated:  October 24, 2023
Notice No.  N2M23-129
File No.  F2M22-65
